question: How do hyperscale engineering operating systems (Google SRE, Google DeepMind, Microsoft Systems, AWS CloudWatch/AppConfig, Meta Infrastructure, OpenAI, Anthropic MCP, Netflix Conductor, Palantir Foundry, SEI CMU, OWASP) integrate multi-agent mission discovery, strategy deliberation, capability-driven tool routing, execution runtimes, verifier independence, and continuous learning into a unified operating loop?
scope: End-to-end 27-state Autonomous Engineering Operating Loop, formal loop contracts, 3-level scope isolation (READ_ONLY, SANDBOX_WRITE, EXTERNAL_WRITE), decision traceability, and meta-governance feedback loops
claims: An integrated operating loop must orchestrate 27 distinct state transitions with strict gate controls to prevent unauthorized execution or scope escalation.
Scope isolation (READ_ONLY, SANDBOX_WRITE, EXTERNAL_WRITE) guarantees that synthetic development modes cannot modify external production repositories without explicit Level 2+ authorization.
evidence: Netflix Conductor and AWS Step Functions enforce explicit state transitions and decision branching at every pipeline gate.
SEI CMU software delivery standards require auditable decision records (WHY_SELECTED, WHY_REJECTED) and evidence payloads before release sign-off.
observations: Decision traceability requires logging explicit confidence, risk, alternatives, and trade-offs for every strategy and capability selection.
Dry-run simulation mode allows end-to-end loop proving without external network or filesystem mutations.
limitations: Operating loop operates in local synthetic mode prior to live commercial API key activation.
recommendation: Implement Autonomous Engineering Operating Loop Engine, 27-state State Machine, Operating Loop Contract Schema, 3-level Scope Model, and Synthetic Proving Test Suite in EOS Control Plane.
